ValueTable.FindRows

ValueTable

FindRows

Available since version 8.0.

Syntax:

FindRows(<FilterParameters>)

Parameters:

<FilterParameters> (required)

Type: Structure.
Contains search criteria: the structure key defines the column to be searched, and the structure value defines the sought value.

Returned value:

Type: Array.
An array of value table rows that meet the search criteria.
Note. The array stores references to value table rows. When table rows change, array values also change.

Description:

Searches for value table rows that meet the specified search criteria.
If a value table includes indexes, the index to be used in the search is selected by exact match of column sets in the index and in the search parameters. The column order does not matter.

Availability:

Server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.

Note:

This method is efficient for selecting nonunique values.

Example:

// EmployeeList - form attribute that displays 

// employee data (ValueTable type).

// The form contains the EmployeeList tabular section.

// It displays EmployeeList data.

// Employee data is selected using a query. 

Query = New Query;
QueryText = 
    "SELECT
    // query text
    // ... 
    ";
Query.Text = QueryText;
EmployeeList = Query.Execute().Unload();
Filter = New Structure();
Filter.Insert("Individual",Catalogs.Individuals.EmptyRef());
Rows = EmployeeList.FindRows(Filter);
If Rows.Count() > 0 Then
    FormItems.EmployeeList.CurrentRow = Rows[0];
EndIf;

Available since:

Available since version 8.0.
